problem: Synthetic bimanual datasets often lack robust task-code generation, rich environmental variability and embodiment-specific feasible grasp choices, undermining downstream generalization.
contribution: RoboTwin2.0 couples MLLM program generation and simulator/VLM feedback with an annotated object library, five-axis domain randomization and embodiment-aware grasp candidates; it releases generator/data/benchmark resources.
algorithm: Generate programs against a skill API, execute10trials per refinement, collect execution logs plus localized visual diagnoses, and repair up to five iterations. Sample object-affordance grasp poses with reachability-biased perturbations and parallel planning; randomize clutter,texture,light,table height and instructions for demonstration synthesis.
observations: Simulation images,proprioception and structured execution results for generation; policy-specific RGB or point-cloud inputs and language. Object functional/grasp points are supplied annotations. Perfect point clouds and clean segmentation benefitDP3 and must not be treated as actual depth-camera observations.
actions: Embodiment-specific bimanual manipulation through object-centric grasp/place APIs and motion planners, then low-level policy trajectories. The task API is richer than arbitrary joint-vector copying; it does not prove valid release semantics on an uninstrumented robot.
embodiment_and_data: 731objects/147categories,50bimanual tasks,100k+generated trajectories across Aloha-AgileX,Piper,Franka,UR5,ARX-X5. Assets mix in-houseRodin reconstructions,Objaverse andPartNet-Mobility. Real sim-to-real tests useCOBOT-Magic andRDT on four tasks.
experiments: Code-generation feedback ablations on10tasks; grasp adaptation over50tasks/five embodiments; randomized-pretraining robustness; four-task real transfer with10real demos,1kvirtual trajectories or their mixture;50taskEasy/Hardbenchmark using50clean demos and100testrollouts per task.
baselines: RoboTwin1.0/2.0 Vanilla,execution-feedback andmultimodal-feedback variants; no grasp adaptation; ACT,DP,DP3,RDT,Pi0; clean versus randomized synthetic pretraining; real-only versus mixed versus synthetic-only policies.

quantitative_result.source: PDF page10 Table4; real setup paragraph on same page
quantitative_result.condition: Unseen background and clutter, averaged over four real tasks
quantitative_result.handover_caveat: On HandoverBlock with seen background+clutter, mixed data achieves12% versus16%real-only; improvement is not universal. Trial denominator for this real table is NOT_EXTRACTED from examined text.
quantitative_result.secondary: PDF page8 Table1 ASR:63.9%RoboTwin1.0+MMfeedback versus71.3%RoboTwin2.0+MMfeedback; these are code-generation metrics, not physical handover success.

limitations: Requires accurate simulation/assets, annotated affordances and embodiment-specific planning. Strong variation still sharply reduces all benchmark policies; generated textures/asset sources have separate rights. VLM diagnoses are fallible and not independent force measurements. A scriptedclose-then-open handover example must not become physical release authorization onExplorer.
hardware_adaptation: ADAPT object-affordance annotations, reproducible domain randomization and benchmark splits. Start with small tasks in the actualROSMASTER geometry. The SAPIEN/CuRobo stack and largeVLAs are not presumed compatible or affordable onNX. SO-101 andROSMASTER are not among the validated five embodiment implementations.
algorithm_detail: The generator uses DeepSeekV3 andMoonshotvision for synthesis/diagnosis; top5ASR explicitly selects best candidates and differs from averageASR. Candidate grasps accommodate workspace limitations rather than assuming the same approach for everyarm. AppendixE usesCuRobo; physical camera perturbations are additionally bounded to1cm in the reported sim-to-real setup.
integration_contract: Retain task/program/seed/asset and embodiment provenance, separate simulator groundtruth from camera observations, declare each randomized factor and preserve failed attempts. Before any realhandovers, use independent receiver-hold evidence or operatorconfirmation rather than transplanting the paper's simple gripper script.
license_evidence: The primarypaper links code/data and enumerates multiple external asset sources; no inspected repository/model/asset license is established by this review. Public availability is not a blanket grant for all meshes or pretrainedweights.
required_experiments: Reproduce a small same-budget generator-feedback comparison; test clean/randomized data at equal trajectorycount; report every failedgeneration denominator; compare calibrated versus randomized realcamera shifts; measure target-model reachability and evaluate actual robot transfer separately from simulator success.
difference_from_explorer: Automated bimanual data generation, visual diagnosis, code repair and heterogeneous grasp adaptation are existing components here. Explorer must justify any novelty in reusable memory/causal repair/verified cooperation against this stronger prior pipeline.

evidence_locations.supports: Realtraining conditions and nonuniform transfer results
